description: Lists the Google Sheets and webhook integrations of a project as {items: [{id, type, name, connectedRiddles}]}. "name" is the value a build takes as publish.integrations.googlesheets / .webhook to connect that integration to a Riddle. A Google Sheet can only be connected in the Creator - with none listed, ask the user to add one there. A Riddle with a FileUpload form field cannot be published without a Google Sheets integration.

projectId.description: The project (team) ID, as returned by project_list. Omit for the project the API key is scoped to.

type.description: Only this kind. Omit for both.

name: integration_list
